title: Bay Area buildings that house three or more hospice or home-health licensees
question: Where do several different hospice and home-health licensees share one building address in the Bay Area?
finding: 11 Bay Area street addresses carry three or more different hospice or home-health licensees (0 in San Francisco); the most at one address is 7 (24301 Southland Dr, Hayward).
how: State licence listing, hospice, hospice facility and home-health licences in the six Bay Area counties; street address with suite, unit and floor removed; licensees counted by normalized name.
limits: Office buildings near hospitals and medical office parks hold many unrelated agencies; executive suites rent to many small firms. A shared address is a reason to look at ownership, not a finding.
